Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You open your hands to the circle, feeling your own warmth flow toward your friends.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
Up to three willing creatures within 3 squares.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Recovery

Offer your strength to the whole circle. Pay 7 HP once before rolling, bypassing resistance and remaining above 0; requires a free hand. Allocate the rolled healing pool among the targets as you choose, minimum 1 allocated per chosen target. Each applies Life resistance to its share, minimum 1 while missing HP.

Weak
Share 10 HP.
Standard
Share 16 HP.
Strong
Share 22 HP; each recipient may reduce temporary Poisoned by 1.
